author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content:
HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES

Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.

If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work.

Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required.

These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. (Yes, we're aware AI art has appeared on our channel before, and we'd love to return to using human artists full-time once the budget supports it, and this is part of that plan.)

Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability:

Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com
Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

Know a talented artist who would be a great fit? Tag them below or share this post to help us find them!

#ChillingTalesForDarkNights #HorrorArt #HorrorIllustration #ArtistsWanted #PaidArtOpportunities

author: Eden Garden Jewelry
title: We Need an Illustrator - Paid Commission
content:
We need an illustrator. We can’t tell you why. Not yet

You’re the one if:
◽️ you design original characters, from first sketch to final art
◽️ you can do turnarounds, expression sheets and pose variations
◽️ anatomy is your strength
◽️ fantasy, flora, fauna and hybrid creatures feel like home
◽️ you draw bodies and skin tones of every kind
◽️ your work is hand-made, digital or traditional
◽️ you’re free in October 2026

It’s a bonus if you animate, tell stories in panels, or love Art Nouveau and folklore.
Paid commission. Your style. Your name on every post. NDA until launch.

To apply, email smm@edengardenjewelry.com or DM with your portfolio, 3 characters you love, and the creature you’ve always wanted to draw

author: Jobs.com
title: Hiring Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist - Fully Remote
content:
HIRING!

Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist
Fully Remote
https://work.turing.com/r/BpA6o2F8Jm

Role Overview

We are looking for talented Illustrators, Sketchers, Cartoonists, Digital Artists, and Concept Artists who can create high-quality artwork from reference images while introducing creative variations and maintaining the character’s identity.
This opportunity is open to interns, freshers, emerging artists, and experienced professionals with strong visual skills and a portfolio that demonstrates creativity, versatility, and attention to detail.

What You’ll Do
1. Create digital character illustrations and sketches using provided reference images.
2. Produce creative variations while maintaining character identity and visual consistency.
3. Apply core fundamentals of composition, color, lighting, perspective, and proportion.
4. Adapt artwork across diverse visual themes based on project requirements.
5. Document creative decisions, style choices, and simple prompt metadata.
6. Deliver polished, high-quality artwork within assigned project timelines.

title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator - Anime Style
content:
Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator

We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds.

Quality level matching the attached characters

Requirements:
- Japanese anime art style (see attached images)
- Experience with 2D game character art
- Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors)
- work needs to match the quality of the attached examples (especially the coloring)

To apply: Send your portfolio.
Feel free to reach out!
